options.name: aaausername
options.description: Enable AppFlow AAA Username logging.

options.name: analyticsauthtoken
options.description: Authentication token to be set by the agent.

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: appnamerefresh
options.description: Interval, in seconds, at which to send Appnames to the configured collectors. Appname refers to the name of an entity (virtual server, service, or service group) in the Citrix ADC.

options.name: auditlogs
options.description: Enable Auditlogs to be sent to the Telemetry Agent

options.name: cacheinsight
options.description: Flag to determine whether cache records need to be exported or not. If this flag is true and IC is enabled, cache records are exported instead of L7 HTTP records

options.name: clienttrafficonly
options.description: Generate AppFlow records for only the traffic from the client.

options.name: connectionchaining
options.description: Enable connection chaining so that the client server flows of a connection are linked. Also the connection chain ID is propagated across Citrix ADCs, so that in a multi-hop environment the flows belonging to the same logical connection are linked. This id is also logged as part of appflow record

options.name: cqareporting
options.description: TCP CQA reporting enable/disable knob.

options.name: distributedtracing
options.description: Enable generation of the distributed tracing templates in the Appflow records

options.name: disttracingsamplingrate
options.description: Sampling rate for Distributed Tracing

options.name: emailaddress
options.description: Enable AppFlow user email-id logging.

options.name: events
options.description: Enable Events to be sent to the Telemetry Agent

options.name: flowrecordinterval
options.description: Interval, in seconds, at which to send flow records to the configured collectors.

options.name: gxsessionreporting
options.description: Enable this option for Gx session reporting

options.name: httpauthorization
options.description: Include the HTTP Authorization header information.

options.name: httpcontenttype
options.description: Include the HTTP Content-Type header sent from the server to the client to determine the type of the content sent.

options.name: httpcookie
options.description: Include the cookie that was in the HTTP request the appliance received from the client.

options.name: httpdomain
options.description: Include the http domain request to be exported.

options.name: httphost
options.description: Include the host identified in the HTTP request that the appliance received from the client.

options.name: httplocation
options.description: Include the HTTP location headers returned from the HTTP responses.

options.name: httpmethod
options.description: Include the method that was specified in the HTTP request that the appliance received from the client.

options.name: httpquerywithurl
options.description: Include the HTTP query segment along with the URL that the Citrix ADC received from the client.

options.name: httpreferer
options.description: Include the web page that was last visited by the client.

options.name: httpsetcookie
options.description: Include the Set-cookie header sent from the server to the client in response to a HTTP request.

options.name: httpsetcookie2
options.description: Include the Set-cookie header sent from the server to the client in response to a HTTP request.

options.name: httpurl
options.description: Include the http URL that the Citrix ADC received from the client.

options.name: httpuseragent
options.description: Include the client application through which the HTTP request was received by the Citrix ADC.

options.name: httpvia
options.description: Include the httpVia header which contains the IP address of proxy server through which the client accessed the server.

options.name: httpxforwardedfor
options.description: Include the httpXForwardedFor header, which contains the original IP Address of the client using a proxy server to access the server.

options.name: identifiername
options.description: Include the stream identifier name to be exported.

options.name: identifiersessionname
options.description: Include the stream identifier session name to be exported.

options.name: logstreamovernsip
options.description: To use the Citrix ADC IP to send Logstream records instead of the SNIP

options.name: lsnlogging
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will send the Large Scale Nat(LSN) records to the configured collectors.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: metrics
options.description: Enable Citrix ADC Stats to be sent to the Telemetry Agent

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: observationdomainid
options.description: An observation domain groups a set of Citrix ADCs based on deployment: cluster, HA etc. A unique Observation Domain ID is required to be assigned to each such group.

options.name: observationdomainname
options.description: Name of the Observation Domain defined by the observation domain ID.

options.name: observationpointid
options.description: An observation point ID is identifier for the NetScaler from which appflow records are being exported. By default, the NetScaler IP is the observation point ID.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: securityinsightrecordinterval
options.description: Interval, in seconds, at which to send security insight flow records to the configured collectors.

options.name: securityinsighttraffic
options.description: Enable/disable the feature individually on appflow action.

options.name: skipcacheredirectionhttptransaction
options.description: Skip Cache http transaction. This HTTP transaction is specific to Cache Redirection module. In Case of Cache Miss there will be another HTTP transaction initiated by the cache server.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: subscriberawareness
options.description: Enable this option for logging end user MSISDN in L4/L7 appflow records

options.name: subscriberidobfuscation
options.description: Enable this option for obfuscating MSISDN in L4/L7 appflow records

options.name: subscriberidobfuscationalgo
options.description: Algorithm(C(MD5) or C(SHA256)) to be used for obfuscating MSISDN

options.name: tcpattackcounterinterval
options.description: Interval, in seconds, at which to send tcp attack counters to the configured collectors. If 0 is configured, the record is not sent.

options.name: templaterefresh
options.description: Refresh interval, in seconds, at which to export the template data. Because data transmission is in UDP, the templates must be resent at regular intervals.

options.name: timeseriesovernsip
options.description: To use the Citrix ADC IP to send Time series data such as metrics and events, instead of the SNIP

options.name: udppmtu
options.description: MTU, in bytes, for IPFIX UDP packets.

options.name: urlcategory
options.description: Include the URL category record.

options.name: usagerecordinterval
options.description: On enabling this option, the NGS will send bandwidth usage record to configured collectors.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: videoinsight
options.description: Enable/disable the feature individually on appflow action.

options.name: websaasappusagereporting
options.description: On enabling this option, NGS will send data used by Web/saas app at the end of every HTTP transaction to configured collectors.
